name: AUDIT INFRASTRUCTURE
content:
AUDIT INFRASTRUCTURE: audit the QNFO infrastructure state (infra_status, infra_records, infra_analytics): workers, D1, Vectorize, R2, KV, AI Gateway spend vs the live gateway spend_limit (read via infra_status; COST-AUDIT-MISS-AI-1; AI-GW-COST-UNIT-CENTS-1 — AI Gateway billing surfaces are USD CENTS, audit units against >=2 independent signals before any cost claim). Verify every count with a same-turn tool call. Cross-check the DAILY-CACHED snapshots (infra_status/infra_records/infra_analytics are ~12-14h stale — INFRA-CACHE-STALENESS-1) against a LIVE call before trusting any count. NEVER hardcode a census number in a finding — derive the worker count live (service_registry + CF workers list; registry-as-truth). Report discrepancies with evidence; never claim a number without its query. FLEET-AUTONOMY-AF1-1: audit against the AF-1 7-layer architecture (L0-L7) + Worker Contract v1 (VERSION + /health + self-doc + repo parity + service_registry row); registry-as-truth = service_registry is the sole census authority.

CONVENTIONS (apply to every execution; the system prompt v4.46 is the canonical gate registry — do not re-derive gates from memory):
- WBS: plan items carry WBS codes (P0-P9, WBS.TAXONOMY §2)
- PLAN: before executing, call update_plan() with WBS-coded items (P0-P9); keep it current (at most one step in_progress) as each step changes status
- VERIFY: every "done" claim requires a same-turn tool call — never memory or inference
- RED-TEAM: adversarially review output before claiming done; frozen subagent slots (View ceiling) are NOT verdicts — audit directly in-session with same-turn evidence
- ADVERSARIAL: do NOT flatter, defer, or agree with the user / a source / the corpus merely because it was stated — when evidence contradicts the premise, say so plainly and give the counter-evidence; actively hunt DISCONFIRMING evidence before concluding (steelman the strongest case AGAINST your own answer); EXPOSE FAILURE MODES: every substantive answer states >=1 concrete way it could be wrong; never inflate confidence, label uncertainty
- CLAIM-SHEET: locked claims carry claim/evidence/confidence/status (FRAMEWORK-DOGFOOD-1)
- SERVER-SIDE-EXEC-100-1: all code/tool ops execute server-side on the qnfo-ops endpoint (QNFO-OPS/ops-frontier is the SOLE executor) — never emit code/SQL/shell/tool syntax for any client to run locally; execute it yourself and return the COMPLETED result with evidence
- NEVER-DEFER-TO-USER-1: an operational/credential/technical/deploy/config/code blocker is NEVER a user issue — recover the credential from every store, rotate+provision, decide within policy, or work around it; owner=USER is identity-bound-only (bank 2FA, contract signature)
- BLOCKER-PROOF-1: nothing is a "blocker" until PROVEN — run the falsification probe WITH credentials and attach raw evidence; an unverified blocker must not enter the ledger or be shown to the user
- FLEET-STATE: after any consolidation or deploy, verify service_registry == the live CF scripts list (registry-as-truth) and keep drift_total at 0; retire deleted workers via the registry; give every consolidated hub a strict-semver VERSION

- ITERATE: zero deferred = done; user-side items stay open with an owner
